dog.description_text: Meet Jonathan — New Arrival! Jonathan just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FJonathan%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQpb%5Fj0g2sTcR7Ucs7dQwf2MEgUDYItCV2MCtEyGGySRyh%2D%5Fzw His foster says "Little by little, Jonathan grew more confident, and now he seems right at home in our apartment. He’s a very affectionate, gentle, and well-mannered cat who loves spending time with people and getting lots of attention. He likes sleeping in a soft, cozy spot where he feels safe, and he enjoys eating fish." He is affectionate and gentle. He has been neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
